neck.anchor_rule: Shared original x column nearest the two face means; brain CV-anterior ventral face and VNC CV-posterior anterior face. No panel horizontal shift.

split.rule: Nonzero brain ROI membership assigns brain, including CV-anterior. Nonzero VNC ROI membership assigns VNC, including CV-posterior. Conflicting memberships stop. Unlabeled vertices use the midpoint between the posterior CV-anterior face and anterior CV-posterior face; equality assigns VNC.

frame.view: Composite layout: brain frontal view, VNC ventral view; not a single projection.

projection: Composite layout: brain frontal view, VNC ventral view; not a single projection.
